role: Post-result diagnostic audit of already registered rules; no new candidate, account, fitted allocation, winner selection or OOS claim.

financial_input_review.scope: Every annual accession consumed to rank the fixed ten-stock cohort during the existing common window, including the preceding month-end decision. Do not select filings by whether validation succeeds.
financial_input_review.originals: Original issuer HTML plus referenced issuer schema/linkbases, captured from the exact accession; primary bytes must match the already sealed original HTML.
financial_input_review.matching: Exact issuer CIK, report end, same annual 330-380 day duration or instant Assets, USD, no dimensions, standard US-GAAP tags. Compare transformed numeric values and retain context/units/decimals/validity and ambiguity.
financial_input_review.validation: Full DTS and XML validation requested; formulas disabled. Missing taxonomies, load errors or validation errors are explicit non-passes, never repaired by dropping facts, changing the source HTML or disabling validation.

account_attribution.scope: Read frozen fills and account marks; no rerun or removal of securities.
account_attribution.identity: Daily equity change = prior inventory*(today open - prior close) + post-open inventory*(close-open) + actual dividend receivable - actual commission/statutory fees - recorded adverse slippage. Noninterest settlement releases do not create PnL.
account_attribution.ending: Report every stock's contribution, closed cycles, retained inventory and aggregate exit reserve separately. Removing a contributor from the sum is an accounting sensitivity only, never a valid counterfactual trading account.
account_attribution.risk: Observed exposure, largest holding and gross drift are descriptive; an 80% target is not a proven continuous hard exposure ceiling.

exposure_diagnostics.benchmarks: Existing hash-frozen SPY/QQQ 2018-2026 public data; gross ex-dividend total returns, zero cash interest. Controls only, not new strategies or inherited net returns.
exposure_diagnostics.regressions: OLS of focal daily net return on intercept, SPY return and (QQQ-SPY) return. HAC Bartlett lag5 with finite-sample correction; report coefficient intervals, conditioning and correlation. Repeat for paired focal-minus-fixed-cohort return as a descriptive differential, not a matched-risk alpha claim.
exposure_diagnostics.bootstrap: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap of the focal-minus-fixed-cohort daily return mean, fixed20-session blocks, 2000 draws, seed20261026. No block/lag/benchmark search.
exposure_diagnostics.limits: Observed historical period and selected focus already seen; uncertainty intervals are descriptive, not selection-corrected significance, causal identification, capacity certification or forward forecasts. The original plan did not predefine a minimum alpha effect; do not invent one after seeing returns.
